Notes: Due to differences in card templating between the various banisher effects (linked triggered abilities vs "until" clause), steps 3, 5, and 7 may return the creature to the battlefield during the resolution of the preceding step rather than creating a separate event.   Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
  Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Cult Conscript.
  When Cult Conscript dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.

  Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
  Repeat.

  Repeat from step 2.
